confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on crowd-sourced aggregates (Numbeo, Expatistan, a travel-budget page) that span 2025-2026 and have small samples; they are not a July 2026 survey. Cocktail and wine rest on one dated venue (Outlook) and a beer-based relationship (cocktail about 1.6x beer, wine about 2x beer), so they are low confidence. Dorm, private hostel, hotel and 3-star anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge with no live listings checked. FX: 0.6947 USD per AUD for 2026-10-16 came from a third-party mirror that attributes it to the RBA. I could not open the official RBA F11.1 table, an RBA overview snapshot is labelled 15 October, and Trading Economics shows 0.6923, so verify the figure against the official table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is South Asia, with Indian mid-sized metro price levels from crowd-sourced indices for food and drink, and general knowledge of Kolkata budget and business-hotel tiers for accommodation.
